Videos of unrest in France and Italy flooded social media on Saturday and Sunday, showing violent clashes between demonstrators and police amid burning buildings and looted storefronts. At multiple points during the chaos, police attempting to contain the violence were forced to retreat. In Paris, for instance, roughly a dozen officers confronted several hundred demonstrators but were unable to make arrests, using rubber-bullet launchers and grenades to keep advancing rioters at bay as they made a gradual retreat. Italian police in Milan, meanwhile, made a similar retreat as hundreds of young rioters threw explosive firecrackers, metal barriers and glass bottles at them in their attempt to occupy a public square. Though France is escalating its response now, demonstrations have been ongoing in the country since last month, with many schools being burned and ransacked by rioters. items.summary_original: Republicans have had their share of good and bad election nights this century, but they’ve usually been able to count on the heartland. Once evenly divided, rural voters have become substantially more Republican over the last two decades. Nearly two-thirds of these voters backed President Trump in the 2024 election. REPUBLICANS FACE BRUTAL MIDTERM HEADWINDS. SIX FORCES COULD HELP THEM DEFY HISTORY. Today, just under half of rural voters say they’ll support the GOP again in November. Like other groups, rural Americans are concerned about paying the bills. Nineteen percent said the rising cost of living is their biggest economic problem in a recent survey , with gas and energy costs not far behind. The Trump administration has, in part, tried to counter those anxieties by talking about job growth and the AI boom, but rural voters are frustrated about those issues too. Less than a quarter of rural voters say the economy is in good shape, and unemployment is a focal point: 8% called a lack of jobs and unemployment their biggest economic issue, and only 28% thought there were good or excellent job opportunities in their communities. "If you turn somebody in and you, let's say report, and you find $1 billion, we are giving a commission to that person of 1%," Trump said. Fox News Digital exclusively reported plans for the program ahead of Tuesday’s announcement. A White House official initially described a $25 million initiative administered by the Justice Department, with rewards of up to $30,000 for tips leading to a successful fraud conviction or significant federal enforcement action. items.summary_original: FIRST ON FOX: The U.S. Navy is quadrupling the ceiling on a contract for AI-powered robots used to inspect warships to $300 million. Just six months after initially tapping the technology to help get ships through maintenance and back to sea faster, the expanded agreement with Pittsburgh-based Gecko Robotics underscores the importance the U.S. military is putting on tech-based solutions. The initial ceiling for the deal was $71 million, but the Navy is pushing to improve fleet readiness amid a widening shipbuilding gap with China. "While the U.S. may not be able to out-manufacture faster than China, we can outsmart the ways that we maintain, operate and are ready with our vessels," Gecko Robotics CEO Jake Loosararian told Fox News Digital. Gecko says its technology can save the Navy up to $8 million in repair costs on a single ship and identify some structural issues up to 50 times faster than traditional inspection methods. INSIDE TRUMP’S DEAL TO GIVE AMERICAN TAXPAYERS A MASSIVE STAKE IN NEW $6.6B SUBMARINE DEAL The company is also unveiling a new robot developed specifically for the Navy that can inspect the steel beneath thick coatings on warship decks without first stripping them away. Dubbed Komodo, the robot scans a ship's deck to map corrosion and material thickness, giving maintenance crews a picture of what needs to be repaired before more invasive work begins. "It's essentially a CAT scan," Loosararian said. "You're basically understanding exactly what's going on."

items.title: وصیت‌نامه مادر جاویدنام سودا اکرمی‌فرد: هر کدام از ما بمیرد، ‌دیگری باید راهش را ادامه دهد
items.summary: سمیرا عینی، مادر جاویدنام سودا اکرمی‌فرد، در «وصیت‌نامه‌ای» که آن را «آخرین حرف‌های» خود با ایرانیان خواند، گفت از اعتراض خود و دخترش و هر آنچه بعد از این بر سر او بیاورند، پشیمان نیست و آنها را آگاهانه انجام داده است.

items.title: پاسخ فردوسی‌پور به قلعه‌نویی: پولی که برای بیش از ۱۰۰ نفر گرفتیم، از پاداش شما کمتر است
items.summary: تقابل رسانه‌ای میان عادل فردوسی‌پور و امیر قلعه‌نویی وارد مرحله جدیدی شده است.

items.title: دانش‌آموزان عکس مجتبی خامنه‌ای را در سطل زباله انداختند
items.summary: تصویر رسیده به ایران‌اینترنشنال نشان می‌دهد دانش‌آموزان مدرسه‌ای در تهران، عکس مجتبی خامنه‌ای را از کتاب خود کنده و در سطل زباله انداخته‌اند.

items.title: رییس دانشگاه علوم پزشکی ایران: رعایت ضوابط پوشش در دانشگاه‌ها و بیمارستان‌ها الزامی است
items.summary: نادر توکلی، رییس دانشگاه علوم پزشکی ایران گفت: «در دانشگاه‌ها، بیمارستان‌ها و محیط‌های اداری و خدماتی، ضوابط مشخصی برای پوشش وجود دارد که باید رعایت شود. ما نیز به این ضوابط و فراهم کردن شرایط لازم برای رعایت پوشش متعارف و متناسب پایبند هستیم.»

items.title: مدیرعامل ایران‌ایر: ۳۰ تا ۴۰ هواپیمای عملیاتی در جنگ از بین رفتند
items.summary: مدیرعامل ایران‌ایر می‌گوید از ۱۳۰ تا ۱۴۰ هواپیمایی که در ایران عملیاتی بودند، ۳۰ تا ۴۰ فروند در جنگ از بین رفتند و ۷۰ تا ۸۰ هواپیما نیز هدف حمله قرار گرفتند.

items.title: چرا وصیت‌نامه علی خامنه‌ای منتشر نشده است؟
items.summary: ادعای نابود شدن وصیتنامه علی خامنه‌ای در بمباران به این معنی است که گویی سندی در این حد از اهمیت در میان وسایل شخصی او نگهداری می شده، که منطقا قابل‌تصور نیست. به‌ویژه با توجه به خاطره مهر و موم وصیت‌نامه سیاسی روح‌الله خمینی در دو نسخه مجزا، که یکی در آستان قدس و دیگری در مجلس خبرگان نگهداری می‌شد.

items.title: تصاویر ماهواره‌ای چه چیزهایی از اقامتگاه تابستانی کیم جونگ اون فاش می‌کنند؟
items.summary: تصاویر ماهواره‌ای از سواحل وونسان، تصویری نادر از تعطیلات و سبک زندگی خانواده کیم جونگ اون ارائه می‌دهد. قایق‌های تفریحی لوکس، تفریحگاه‌های ساحلی و مجموعه‌های اختصاصی، در تضاد آشکار با زندگی روزمره بسیاری از شهروندان کره شمالی قرار دارند که همچنان با محدودیت‌های اقتصادی و کمبودهای گسترده مواجه‌اند.

items.title: ژاپن ماموریت تاریخی نمونه‌برداری از قمر مریخ را آغاز کرد
items.summary: وب‌سایت اسپیس گزارش داد ژاپن ماموریت «اکتشاف قمرهای مریخ» را آغاز کرد. فضاپیمای ام‌ام‌اکس قرار است در سال ۲۰۲۷ به مریخ برسد، روی فوبوس فرود آید و نمونه‌برداری کند. در صورت موفقیت، کپسول حامل نمونه‌ها سال ۲۰۳۱ در استرالیا فرود می‌آید.

items.summary_original: Vice President JD Vance declined to endorse Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's reelection bid, saying he intends to stay out of Israel's election despite President Donald Trump throwing his support behind the Israeli leader. During an interview Monday with Mark Halperin on " 2WAY Tonight ," Vance said his focus remains on U.S. candidates ahead of the midterms, Politico reported . "The president has the most effective endorsement in American or international political history," Vance said. "I endorse American candidates , and that’s where I’m focused on in the midterms. So I’m not getting involved in Israeli elections." OMAR RAID DRAWS OMINOUS WARNING FROM VANCE AS HE BLASTS PROGRESSIVE REP'S 'RAGE' TOWARD AMERICA However, Vance made clear that his decision should not be interpreted as opposition to Netanyahu. "I’m not anti-endorsing him. I’m not pro-endorsing him. I’m not getting involved in Israeli elections," the vice president added. The comments come one day after Trump gave Netanyahu his "Complete and Total Endorsement" in a lengthy Truth Social post, praising the prime minister as a key U.S. ally and partner in confronting Iran . " Bibi Netanyahu has been a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combatting the Islamic Republic of Iran," Trump wrote. items.summary: خبرگزاری هرانا گزارش داد همایون شبانکاره، شهروند ۲۲ ساله محبوس در ندامتگاه مرکزی کرج، از سوی شعبه دوم دادگاه انقلاب کرج به اتهام‌های محاربه و جاسوسی به اعدام محکوم شده است.

items.summary: قرار است فضاپیمایی در قالب یک ماموریت بلندپروازانه پرتاب شود تا ۱۰ گرم غبار از یکی از قمرهای مریخ را به زمین بازگرداند.

items.summary: عربستان سعودی تصمیم گرفته است کنفرانس مهم سرمایه‌گذاری خود را که به «داووس صحرا» مشهور است تا سال آینده به تعویق بیندازد.این تصمیم پس از حملات مرگبار اخیر حوثی‌های مورد حمایت جمهور اسلامی و هم‌زمان با گسترش درگیری‌ها در خاورمیانه اتخاذ شده که فعالیت‌های تجاری را مختل کرده است.

items.summary: در حالی که دونالد ترامپ، رییس‌جمهوری آمریکا، از مذاکره با مسکو درباره ایران خبر داده است، سرگئی لاوروف، وزیر امور خارجه روسیه، در تهران با محسن رضایی، عباس عراقچی و مسعود پزشکیان دیدار و بر ادامه همکاری با جمهوری اسلامی تاکید کرد.

items.summary: دونالد ترامپ، رییس‌جمهوری آمریکا، بار دیگر مخالفت خود با ولودیمیر زلنسکی، رییس‌جمهوری اوکراین، را آشکار کرد و گفت فردی غیر از زلنسکی باید به نمایندگی از کی‌یف برای پایان دادن به جنگ با روسیه مذاکره کند. او همچنین گفت آماده شرکت در دیداری سه‌جانبه با روسای‌جمهوری چین و روسیه است.

items.title: روایت دنیای مخفی خرابکاری علیه پوتین در داخل روسیه
items.summary: دو مرد روس که مخفیانه برای سرویس‌های اطلاعاتی اوکراین کار می‌کنند، روایت‌های نادری از عملیات‌هایی ارائه کرده‌اند که می‌گویند در آن‌ها نقش داشته‌اند؛ عملیاتی که دارایی‌ها و نیروهای نظامی را در داخل روسیه هدف قرار داده است.

items.title: پاسخ دولت فرانسه به نگرانی‌های امنیتی؛ بازی پی‌اس‌جی و بارسلونا برگزار می‌شود

items.title: ترامپ کمک روسیه و چین به تهران را ناچیز و وضعیت را «بسیار مثبت» توصیف کرد
items.summary: دونالد ترامپ، رییس‌جمهوری آمریکا، گفت روسیه و چین می‌توانستند کمک بیشتری به جمهوری اسلامی کنند، اما حمایتشان بسیار اندک بوده و او این وضعیت را «بسیار مثبت» می‌داند. او همچنین برای نشست با رهبران این دو کشور درباره خلع سلاح هسته‌ای اعلام آمادگی کرد.

items.summary_original: As images of burning cars and historic buildings in France and Italy ricochet across Europe, leaders in Hungary and Poland are seizing the moment, not to address the unrest, but to redefine the migration debate. Both Hungary and Poland have laid down markers on allowing migrants into their nations. Even to the point of being fined and sanctioned by the European Union courts for refusing to open their gates to unchecked immigration, in Hungary’s case under former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, while Poland faced sanctions in 2025. Eurostat’s latest available figures show that in 2025 France had almost 10 million and Italy about 7 million foreign-born residents. Poland had roughly 1 million foreign-born residents, while Hungary had less than 700,000, with most born in other EU countries and in Poland’s case about half came from Ukraine. items.summary_original: OTTAWA: Residents of Alberta began voting Monday in a non-binding referendum that will determine whether the western-Canadian province should pursue separation from Canada . The vote comes at a time when the province is mourning the deaths of four soldiers , while dozens of others were injured from a fast-moving fire that burned through a military base in Alberta. While the results of a poll involving 1,021 respondents released by Abacus Data on Saturday showed that 74% of decided voters favor Alberta remaining within the Canadian Confederation, the independence issue won’t disappear for the nearly 30% who want Alberta’s government to begin the process to hold a binding provincial referendum on whether Alberta should separate from Canada, according to veteran separatist organizer Cory Morgan, who leads a group called Pathway to Independence. "It will say that about one in three Albertans have had it," Morgan told Fox News Digital. "There is a big rift within Alberta and if things don’t change, it will be a growing faction in this province — so this vote is an important one." items.summary_original: U.S. lawmakers are growing concerned with ongoing violence gripping the small NATO nation of Albania as police clashed with protesters in the capital Tirana. The violence continued for a sixth straight day on Sunday as the lawmakers issued warnings on social media to Albanian authorities. "The Albanian people deserve freedom, rule of law, and institutional accountability. The government must refrain from all violence against protestors. Young people deserve a voice in the future of their country," Republican South Carolina Representative Joe Wilson posted on X. Rep. Robert Aderholt, R-Ala., posted on X that: "All parties must reject violence, and the government must respect the rights of peaceful protesters. Albania’s young people deserve a voice in shaping their nation’s future." Aderholt and Wilson were joined by Rep. Keith Self, R-Texas, who stated on X: "The protests in Albania are a culmination of the people’s distrust of corrupt politicians and fatigue over the total disregard for the rule of law." Police said 388 people had been charged with criminal offenses during the demonstrations, and an unspecified number of protesters and police have been injured, according to Reuters. The U.S. Embassy in Albania called on all demonstrators to exercise their right to protest peacefully with no violent rioting, urging restraint and calm on all sides. items.summary_original: As France's fiery student protests merged with a nationwide revolt on Saturday, a communist leader and academic, Vijay Prashad, celebrated the unrest with a message linking protests across three continents. "Paris-New Delhi-Buenos Aires," Prashad posted on X , borrowing a line from the British punk band The Clash: "Let fury have the hour, anger can be power." Prashad was important not only for what he said, but for who he is: executive director of Tricontinental Ltd., a nonprofit funded by an American-born Marxist tech tycoon, Neville Roy Singham, who lives in Shanghai. items.summary_original: Pope Leo XIV made a remarkable return to the Vatican on Sunday, appearing before thousands of Catholic faithful in St. Peter's Square just five days after undergoing surgery to remove a cancerous tumor from his lung. The 71-year-old pontiff delivered his traditional Angelus prayer from a window overlooking the square, marking his first official engagement since being discharged Saturday from Rome's Gemelli hospital , where doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung. Leo thanked the faithful for their prayers and support throughout his hospitalization, saying his recent health struggles had brought him closer to those suffering from illness. He also expressed gratitude to the doctors, nurses and hospital staff who cared for him following the operation. POPE LEO XIV DISCHARGED FROM HOSPITAL, WILL RETURN TO VATICAN AFTER SURGERY TO REMOVE LUNG CANCER The first American-born pope said he planned to gradually resume his regular activities with God's help and the continued prayers of the faithful. During his Angelus address, Leo reflected on one of Jesus' best-known teachings, "Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor's, and to God the things that are God's," urging Christians to live with integrity and resist hypocrisy. His return came sooner than expected after doctors initially anticipated a hospital stay of approximately one week following Tuesday's surgery . items.summary_original: A historic building in the French town of Limoges, about three hours south of Paris, has been "largely lost" after it was set on fire by rioters as demonstrations continue across France . The Limoges Town Hall was built in 1883, and was made a historic landmark in 1975. "The roof has collapsed onto lower floors, except the west wing, and two-thirds of the exterior has already disappeared," the local prefect, Maurice Barate, told the AFP news agency. MASSIVE FIRE DESTROYS 400-YEAR-OLD FOOD MARKET, LEAVING HISTORIC LANDMARK IN RUINS Barate called it "a deliberate act by hooligans," adding that it was a "catastrophe for heritage." The destruction came as far-left anti-government protests and violent clashes entered their fourth week in the European country over the cost of living. On Saturday, outgoing President Emmanuel Macron wrote on social media: "There is no place for violence in our republic." items.summary_original: Three men in Mexico received 158-year prison sentences Friday for the murders of Australian surfers Callum and Jake Robinson and their American friend Carter Redd Rhoad. A federal judge in the town of Ensenada, Baja California sentenced Jesús Gerardo García, Irineo Francisco and Ángel Jesús each to 158 years and nine months in prison for murder, robbery with violence and vehicle theft with violence. An accomplice of García's — Ary Gisell Silva Raya — was also convicted of aggravated robbery with violence and vehicle theft with violence and sentenced to 20 years in November after agreeing to an abbreviated trial. AMERICANS WARNED POPULAR TRAVEL ROUTES THIS SUMMER COULD CARRY CRIME AND KIDNAPPING RISKS García, Francisco and Jesús were convicted last week of killing the Robinson brothers and Rhoad, which authorities said was carried out in order to steal the tires from the deceased men's truck. "The attackers pull out a gun they were carrying and kill the person who initially resisted the robbery, then on the other two," Baja California prosecutor María Elena Andrade said, according to a report from The Associated Press . Bregeon added that Macron called on his ministers to come up with "concrete responses" to the unrest within weeks. Police used tear gas and water cannons Saturday to disperse violent groups in the capital, where people wearing hoods and masks threw fireworks and other objects at officers in the Place de la République. items.summary_original: Thousands of supporters gathered outside Gemelli Hospital in Rome Saturday yelling "Papa!" after Pope Leo XIV was released after surgery to remove a cancerous node in his lung. The Holy See announced early Saturday he would be leaving to return to the Vatican. "Following the doctors’ assessment this morning, Pope Leo XIV will be discharged today from Gemelli Hospital, where he was hospitalized for surgery on his right lung," a statement from the Holy See read. "He will leave the hospital in the early afternoon and return to the Vatican. Tomorrow, he will lead the Angelus prayer from the window of the papal apartment." The pope received blood tests and a chest X-ray Saturday, both of which confirmed he is well enough to return to the Vatican, according to Vatican News. Before he departed, Pope Leo reportedly visited the children's oncology ward. While in the hospital, the Pope received letters from some of the children in the ward. "Pope Leo, our prayers are for you," a girl named Eleonora, who had been receiving treatment in the oncology ward, wrote to him, according to letters released by Vatican News. "May God, the Most Holy Virgin, and the guardian angels always protect you," she added. Eleanora's mother told the Pope that she was now healthy, according to the Vatican. "Faith moves mountains," Eleanora wrote to Pope Leo. "God has heard our prayers." items.title: بی‌طرفی، راستی‌آزمایی و پاسخ‌گویی؛ چرا بی‌بی‌سی فارسی بر این اصول ایستادگی می‌کند؟
items.summary: این مطلب توضیح می‌دهد که چرا بی‌بی‌سی فارسی در یکی از پرتنش‌ترین دوره‌های تاریخ معاصر ایران بر اصول بنیادین روزنامه‌نگاری، از جمله بی‌طرفی، راستی‌آزمایی، استقلال تحریریه و پاسخ‌گویی، پافشاری می‌کند. در این مقاله، با مرور شیوه تصمیم‌گیری‌های تحریریه، فرآیند راستی‌آزمایی اخبار، نحوه انتخاب مهمانان و برخورد با خطاها و انتقادها، تشریح می‌شود که هدف بی‌بی‌سی نه جانبداری از هیچ طرف، بلکه ارائه گزارشی دقیق، مستقل و مبتنی بر شواهد است تا مخاطبان بتوانند بر اساس اطلاعات قابل اعتماد، خود درباره رویدادها قضاوت کنند.

items.title: 'کودتای خزنده' در سپاه؛ نوار صوتی جلسه‌ای محرمانه در زمان جنگ
items.summary: با گذشت چهل سال از آغاز جنگ ایران و عراق، هنوز اطلاعات مرتبط با مقاطع مهمی از جنگ، از آرشیوهای محرمانه خارج نشده است. یکی از جلسات مهمی که در آن فرماندهی جنگ مورد انتقاد سپاهیان ناراضی قرار می‌گیرد، اوایل آذر ۶۳ برگزار می‌شود که در دهه‌های اخیر، رسانه‌های حکومتی ایران روایت‌های پراکنده و به‌شدت تحریف شده‌ای را از آن منتشر کرده‌اند.
